messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert — realtime p99 spike detected for streaming in eu-central-1. Metric: stream.response.p99 jumped 180ms -> 680ms over 5m. Affected route: /v1/generate (stream). Paging @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Ack, joining. Starting triage: grafana, kvcache hit rates, queue depth, recent deploys. @alex_g @priya please standby.

alex_g: I'm looking at per-host p99 and RPC queue depths now. Initial glance shows 4 hosts in eu-tier-B with high tail and CPU steal spikes.

priya: Checking model variants and rpc errors. Running quick logs for toolchain and quantized fallback errors.

sre-oncall: Can someone run this prom query and paste results? I want node-level p99 and inflight requests.

sre-oncall: ```promql
max_over_time(stream_response_p99{region="eu-central-1"}[5m]) by (node)
```

jamie: Ran it — nodes eu-b-03, eu-b-04, eu-b-05 show spikes around ~700ms. KV cache hitrate on those nodes dropped from 95%->60% in same window.

alex_g: That looks like a KV-cache miss storm + queue buildup. Proposal: shift traffic off eu-tier-B to eu-tier-A for 10m and enable incremental cache warmers. I can trigger routing change via the admin API.

mike_cs: Any visible customer impact? Support dashboard shows ~12 degraded sessions, 2 timeouts reported (customer IDs provided). I'm preparing comms if it persists.

priya: Also seeing an uptick in small OOM events on eu-b-04 in the last 6m post-deploy at 5389999999 — possible memory pressure causing cache thrashing.

sre-oncall: Ok do the routing change, @alex_g — we'll monitor p99 and kv hit rates. Open a bridge if mitigation needs hands-on.

alex_g: Executing reroute now:

alex_g: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/routing/shift" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from_pool":"eu-tier-B","to_pool":"eu-tier-A","percent":100}'
```

alex_g: :white_check_mark: Shift issued. Watching metrics.

jamie: After shift, p99 dropped to ~260ms within 90s on aggregate. eu-b nodes show decreasing inflight and KV hitrate recovering slowly.

sre-oncall: Great. Marking as mitigated for now. Will keep watch for 30m, but this looks like a capacity/memory issue on eu-tier-B after that deploy. @priya can you capture logs and open a rollback/patch PR if needed.

priya: Captured logs and created a trace link. Hypothesis: kernel tunable changed file-buffer reclaim behavior in that deploy container image — causing cache eviction under load. Filing issue and draft rollback.

mike_cs: Notifying the two impacted customers with a heads-up. No wider outage reported.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1437 for follow-up (sev3). Assignees: eng-runtime, eng-ml, oncall-sre.

sre-oncall: Closing live mitigation thread — partial mitigation successful, routing shift restored SLOs. Follow-up: postmortem, deploy rollback evaluation, and tighter pre-deploy memory checks. I'll update the incident ticket.

alex_g: Adding runbook note for automatic low-kv-hit fallback routing and a quick health check pre-deploy.

jamie: :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Thanks team. Stand down unless metrics reflare. "
